description_en: Interrupts an instance change task. This operation is valid only for instances in the active state. After the interruption, the instance enters the suspended state
description_zh: 中断实例变更任务，仅对状态为生效中的实例有效，中断后，实例进入变更中断（suspended）状态
name: InterruptElasticsearchTask

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is displayed only when an exception occurs
Code.description_zh: 错误码。仅当返回异常时显示

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is displayed only when an exception occurs
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。仅当返回异常时显示
Message.example: The cluster is running tasks or in an error status. Try again later.

Result.description_en:
The returned result. Valid values:

true: The change is interrupted.
false: The change failed to be interrupted
Result.description_zh:
返回结果：

true：中断变更成功
false：中断变更失败
